optimizedDescription.value: Pure bounded traversal computes filtered semantic blast radius, risk, hierarchy, route evidence, and logical requirement coverage.

optimizedContext.value:
# Traversal

## Rules
- `getUpstream` follows reverse `CALLS`; `getDownstream` follows forward `CALLS`. Default `maxDepth:3`; results grouped 1-indexed; cycles dedupe at shallowest depth.
- `TraversalOptions`: `maxDepth`, `includeFiles` default true. `TraversalResult`: root, levels, unique total, truncation.
- BFS batches each frontier via store symbol/relation batch APIs; no call per symbol/type. File/multi-file/change aggregation uses fixed bounded concurrency. Multi-file shares memoized read view+budget. Width never causes `StoreOverloadError`.
- Hotspots fetch all candidates incoming `EXTENDS|IMPLEMENTS|OVERRIDES` in one logical batch, fold counts in memory; preserve filters/scoring/rank/risk.
- `analyzeImpact` returns target; depth-1 direct, depth-2 indirect, depth-3+ transitive counts; risk; unique files; depth-bearing symbols; processes; required `affectedSpecs`; `omittedCounts:{tests,ignored}`.
- Dependency traversal treats `CALLS`, `CONSTRUCTS`, `USES_TYPE`, `EXTENDS`, `IMPLEMENTS`, `OVERRIDES` as direction-aware blast-radius edges.
- Optional filter across symbol/file/multi-file/spec/public-binding selects result types `files|symbols|specs`, symbol kinds, workspaces, categories. Categories default `source`; exclusions win; empty inclusion admits all.
- Backend filtered-impact queries enforce eligibility before collection/count/risk/limits. Upstream/bidirectional BFS stops at non-admitted file boundaries; tests/ignored cannot bridge production. Explicit test/ignored target may traverse downstream.
- Result selection controls materialized collections, not reachability. Specs-only still traverses admitted code. `affectedSpecs` empty unless requested, then derives from admitted `COVERS_FILE`/`COVERS_SYMBOL`. Filtering precedes limits.
- Risk: LOW=0–2 direct, no indirect; MEDIUM=3–5 direct or any indirect; HIGH=6+ direct or 10+ total; CRITICAL=20+ total or target in 3+ flows.
- `analyzeFileImpact`: load file symbols, bounded impacts, dedupe shallowest symbols, union files/spec evidence, max risk. `analyzeFilesImpact`: aggregate files/symbols, sum depth counts, max risk; every input depth 0.
- `coveringSpecs`: batch reverse coverage for deduped input/reached files and logical symbols. One spec with minimum depth plus every distinct `{kind,target,depth}`; deterministic depth/spec/evidence order. File evidence independent; symbol evidence augments.
- Logical coverage maps reached physical declarations to logical IDs, dedupes, performs one bounded reverse lookup. Target declarations participate at depth 0. Evidence links covered logical target to every contributing physical declaration.
- Never query `COVERS_SYMBOL` using physical `SymbolNode.id`. Unmapped declarations excluded without fallback; if no mappings, skip lookup and classify physical-only/coverage-not-applicable.
- `analyzeSpecImpact` traverses `DEPENDS_ON`, `COVERS_FILE`, `COVERS_SYMBOL`; upstream returns dependents+covered code, downstream dependencies+reachable code within depth.
- `detectChanges` finds changed-file symbols, bounded upstream impact, aggregate files/symbols/risk/summary.
- Resolve selector to one proven target before traversal. Unqualified: case-exact then case-insensitive exact only; no fuzzy/prefix/component. Ambiguity returns bounded deterministic candidates without traversal.
- Owner-qualified lookup uses stored `qualified_name`; zero never falls back to terminal name; multiple all reported, none traversed. Traversal never parses human syntax.
- Public-binding impact separates exact surface/export consumers (including re-exports) from all canonical-symbol dependents; retains selected binding, canonical target, ordered chain; never merges ambiguous exports.
- Logical-target impact seeds every physical declaration occurrence, then traverses physical dependency edges. Aggregate reached declarations by logical identity when mapped; retain every physical edge/location; preserve declaration-only results.
- Logical target appears once at shallowest semantic depth. Physical occurrence counts and logical-target counts use distinct named units. Risk uses documented semantic unit and cannot change solely from equivalent extra declarations.
- Exact declaration impact stays physical and is never widened. Exact public-binding impact keeps selected-route and canonical-target views separate.
- Hierarchy traversal preserves language precedence/direction across contracts, overrides, inheritance, traits, mixins, embedding, promotion, provable interfaces; logical symbol counted once; deterministic bounded cycle-safe order.
- All operations stateless read-only functions in `domain/services/`.

## Constraints
- Default depth 3; caller override allowed.
- Fixed risk thresholds; shallowest-depth cycle dedupe.
- Bounded batching/concurrency across width/input size.
- No store mutation, lifecycle/state retention, or `@specd/core` dependency.
